blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: The received book combines poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, repeated accounts, restoration collections, nation oracles, and an appendix produced through a long compositional and textual history. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken. Interpretations differ on some details.

A literary feature to notice is that Chapters 1; 2-25; 26-29; 30-33; 34-45; 46-51; and 52 provide a practical outline of Masoretic Jeremiah without settling its composition. This form helps organize the chapter's claims. Notice it before drawing broader conclusions from a single phrase or image. The evidence leaves some details unresolved.
